entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: ¶Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified? {full...: Heb. of lips}

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed? {lies: or, devices}

words.text: , shall no man make thee ashamed

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: For thou hast said, My doctrine [is] pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that [they are] double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee [less] than thine iniquity [deserveth].

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: ¶Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: [It is] as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know? {as high...: Heb. the heights of heaven}

words.text: ? {as high...: Heb. the heights of heaven}

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: The measure thereof [is] longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him? {cut...: or, make a change} {hinder...: Heb. turn him away?}

words.text: him? {cut...: or, make a change} {hinder...: Heb. turn him away?}

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider [it]?

words.text: also; will he not then consider

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: For vain man would be wise, though man be born [like] a wild ass's colt. {vain: Heb. empty}

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: ¶If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: If iniquity [be] in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

words.text: For then shalt thou lift up

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: Because thou shalt forget [thy] misery, [and] remember [it] as waters [that] pass away:

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And [thine] age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning. {be cleared...: Heb. arise above}

words.text: , thou shalt be as the morning

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig [about thee, and] thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

words.text: [about thee, and] thou shalt take thy rest

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make [thee] afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee. {make suit...: Heb. intreat thy face}

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope [shall be as] the giving up of the ghost. {they shall...: Heb. flight shall perish from them} {the giving...: or, a puff of breath}

words.text: . {they shall...: Heb. flight shall perish from them} {the giving...: or, a puff of breath}
